messages.author: jinalgupta.
messages.content:
<@1469322991270760502> 
According to our records, the deadline for CS Week 4 was 5th March, and an extension had already been provided until 8th March. We noticed that 38 out of the 42 case studies were submitted by 5th March, while the remaining ones were submitted on 9th March, which was after the extended deadline.
Due to this, we regret that we are unable to revert the HPs for this phase. We truly appreciate the effort you have put into completing the case studies.
We encourage you to focus on the upcoming phases of the internship, where you will have more opportunities to earn HPs. Wishing you the very best for the next activities!
